Class DoubleBuilderPrestige

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.model.cards.buildings.effects.DoubleBuilderPrestige
All Implemented Interfaces:
EffectStrategy
public class DoubleBuilderPrestige extends Object implements EffectStrategy
Implements the EffectStrategy to represent a specific building effect. When applied, this effect grants the player additional prestige points equal to the prestige points already provided by the Builder cards present in their tribe, effectively doubling their value.

      public void applyEffect(Player player, Game game)
      Applies the double builder prestige effect to the specified player. Iterates through the player's tribe to find all builder cards and adds their prestige points to the player's total score.
